spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-4 to p-8) to ensure calm and readable surfaces. Mobile-first layout with bottom tab navigation.

shadows.light: shadow-sm to shadow-md, subtle ambient shadows with a hint of emerald (e.g. shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(5,150,105,0.05)])
shadows.dark: shadow-none, rely on 1px border (#334155) and surface color differences

navigation.bottom_tabs: Clean, label-less or small label tabs. Active tab highlighted with the emerald primary accent.
navigation.headers: Translucent glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl) or solid background depending on scroll.

cards.style: Subtle rounded cards (rounded-2xl) with minimal borders. Avoid heavy shadows.

buttons.primary: Solid emerald background, pill-shaped (rounded-full), bold text.
buttons.secondary: Outline or subtle tonal background (bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-900/30) with primary color text.

tasbih_counter.style: Massive circular touch area. Tactile neumorphic or subtle glow effect to invite tapping. Needs tactile/haptic feedback on interaction.

home_tab.next_prayer_card: Hero element. Use a subtle geometric Islamic pattern background with an emerald overlay. Large countdown timer in a monospaced or clean sans font.
home_tab.today_prayer_list: Dense vertical list. Highlight the active/next prayer with a distinct background tint (e.g., bg-emerald-50) and a subtle left border (border-l-4 border-emerald-500).
home_tab.quick_actions: Horizontal scrollable row or a 2x2 bento grid for actions like 'Read Quran', 'Daily Duas', etc.

quran_tab.surah_list: List view. Each row should have a subtle number indicator, English name on left, beautiful Arabic calligraphy on right.
quran_tab.reading_screen: Distraction-free mode. Large Arabic text centered, clear English translation below it. Floating action button for quick settings (font size, translations) and bookmarking.
quran_tab.pro_gating: Subtle lock icons on premium translations/reciters, styled elegantly without being aggressive.

azkar_tab.category_grid: 2-column grid. Soft pastel/neutral tinted cards with minimal line icons for Morning, Evening, Travel, etc.
azkar_tab.tasbih_counter: Focus on the tap interaction. Large central touch zone, counter clearly visible at top. Reset and Settings as smaller secondary actions.

settings_tab.layout: Standard categorized list layout. Grouped by 'Prayer Settings', 'Quran', 'Preferences', and 'Account'.
settings_tab.pro_toggle: Premium-looking banner or toggle card using perhaps a deeper shade of emerald or a subtle gold/yellow accent to denote 'Pro'.

motion_and_interactions.general: Smooth, subtle transitions. No jarring animations.
motion_and_interactions.tasbih_tap: Scale down slightly (scale-95) on press, with haptic feedback.
motion_and_interactions.list_entrance: Staggered fade-up for Surah lists and Azkar categories.

image_urls.description: Silhouette of a mosque dome at sunset. Can be used behind the next prayer card with an overlay.
Man sitting reading a book in mosque. Good for empty states or welcome screens.
Islamic geometric mosaic pattern. Great to use with low opacity (e.g., 5-10%) as a texture on the Home or Quran screens.

testing.instructions: All touchable elements, list items, and key textual information MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g. `data-testid="next-prayer-card"`, `data-testid="tasbih-counter-button"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard React Native components (View, Text, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView, FlatList). Style using NativeWind/Tailwind applying the provided color palette and spacing rules. Ensure bottom tab navigation is implemented using React Navigation. Follow the light/dark mode variables strictly. The app should feel premium, calm, and highly readable.
